phase: P04 (batch 2: HTML safety, product persistence, association visibility, categories, size guides, media)
scope: infra/security/sanitize-html.adapter.ts and every HTML-bearing write path (product longDescHtml and text fields, editorial look story/title, size guide body/title); storefront rendering of product HTML
reviewed_without_change: HTML sanitiser: strict tag/attribute allow-list, scripts/styles/iframes removed, links limited to http/https/mailto/tel, images to http/https, no protocol-relative URLs, rel=noopener on links. Product descriptions, look stories and size-guide bodies are sanitised on create and update; titles and SEO fields are stripped to text. The storefront only injects the sanitised product description.
Category moves reject self-parenting and cycles; categories with subcategories cannot be deleted.
Catalog writes, media management, tags, size guides and variants remain admin-only (batch 1).

findings.problem: Product save wrote the product row, deleted its image links and recreated them as separate statements. A failure part-way (e.g. a dropped connection) committed the new product fields and left the product with no or partial images.
findings.change: The product row and image list are written in one transaction.
findings.verification: ProductSaveAtomicity integration spec with an injected failure on the second image insert: baseline committed the new title and partial images; fixed the product keeps its original title and both original images.

findings.problem: Follow-on to P04-01: four public association routes returned the ids of draft products and draft looks (look products, a product's looks, popular products, tag products), revealing that unreleased items exist.
findings.change: For shoppers, a look that is not live returns 404 for its product list, a product that is not live returns 404 for its looks, and only live product/look ids are returned elsewhere; staff still see every association.
findings.verification: catalog-visibility E2E association case: baseline returned draft ids; fixed only live ids for shoppers, all ids for staff.

findings.problem: Media assets created from product image URLs were always recorded as image/png, and product image URLs accepted any string although they are rendered on the storefront.
findings.change: Image MIME type derived from the file extension (jpeg/png/webp/gif/avif/svg, otherwise application/octet-stream); product image URLs must be https.
findings.verification: Integration case records image/jpeg, image/webp and image/png for matching URLs (query strings ignored).

tests.new: integration ProductSaveAtomicity (2), E2E catalog-visibility association case (1)
tests.baseline: Rollback case failed on the old repository ('Changed title' committed); association case failed on the old controllers (draft ids returned).
tests.database_suites: All E2E and integration suites: 124 tests in 40 files pass
tests.final: 1502 unit tests in 116 files; root/tooling tsc; 7/7 workspace type-checks; API client drift check

follow_ups: Tag product totals still count hidden products for shoppers (items are filtered); exact totals need the visibility filter inside the association query.
Product create/update fields have no length limits (admin-only input); prices of 0 are accepted.
Rows written before the HTML sanitiser existed are not re-sanitised; consider a one-off migration that re-sanitises stored HTML.
